confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Hong Kong price levels for July 2026; no live booking pages or listings were consulted. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel rates vary widely by district and season and are least certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (roughly 2x and 1.5x) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. The FX figure comes from web search summaries attributing it to the RBA latest-rates page; I did not open that page, so verify it against the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; anchors were estimated directly from Hong Kong's own price levels, with summer hotel and hostel demand considered.
